section_summary.extract_value: This section presents mediation analyses examining body appreciation as a mediator between various predictors (discrepancy perfectionism, order perfectionism, attachment anxiety, and restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages) and intuitive eating. Three of four hypothesized indirect effects were significant: body appreciation fully mediated the relationship between discrepancy perfectionism and intuitive eating, and partially mediated the relationships between attachment anxiety and intuitive eating, and between restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages and intuitive eating.
section_summary.evidence_source: Entire section describes mediation analysis results from a single study examining indirect effects through body appreciation.
